title: UE is not using 5GS services with control plane CIoT 5GS optimization

entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request services from AMF by sending SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to AMF to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: Service type
entities.description: IE in SERVICE REQUEST message indicating type of service requested (e.g., mobile terminated services, high priority access, emergency services).

entities.name: Uplink data status
entities.description: IE indicating PDU sessions with pending uplink user data to be sent.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status
entities.description: IE indicating PDU sessions allowed to be transferred to 3GPP access.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: IE containing encapsulated NAS message for non-cleartext IEs when sent from 5GMM-IDLE mode.

entities.name: 5G-S-TMSI
entities.description: IE containing valid 5G-S-TMSI identifier for UE identification.

entities.name: T3517
entities.description: Timer started by UE when initiating service request procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by UE after sending SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode with non-cleartext IEs
entities.description: Condition where UE sends SERVICE REQUEST from 5GMM-IDLE mode needing to send non-cleartext IEs.

entities.name: UE configured for high priority access
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for high priority access in selected PLMN.

entities.name: UE starts timer T3517
entities.description: UE behavior to start timer T3517 when initiating service request.

relations.description: Service request procedure involves sending SERVICE REQUEST message.
SERVICE REQUEST message contains Service type IE.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain Uplink data status IE.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain Allowed PDU session status IE.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain NAS message container IE for non-cleartext IEs.
Service request procedure starts timer T3517.
Service request procedure requires UE to enter 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
Condition of 5GMM-IDLE mode with non-cleartext IEs requires inclusion of NAS message container IE.
Condition of high priority access configuration affects setting of Service type IE.
UE behavior property starts timer T3517.
